name: Platform @Bank Quay modular AI data centre
developer: Dante FS Group / Platform Data Centres UK
notes: Former Unilever/Crosfields factory site at Bank Quay acquired by Dante FS Group; proposed modular AI/HPC data centre up to 260,000 sq ft, subject to planning approval; demolition reported underway.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Kyndryl Warwick Data Center
notes: Public listings identify an operational Warwick data centre associated with IBM/Kyndryl; DCD notes IBM built a primary facility in Warwick for Co-operative Bank. Capacity not found in public sources.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Six Degrees Studley North Data Centre
notes: Studley, Warwickshire colocation facility; public listing cites 1.5MVA power supply, but no IT MW figure was verified.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: J Mould Reading Quarry energy-recovery powered data centre
notes: West Berkshire planning report for Reading Quarry states the data centre would utilise approximately 40MW of electrical energy; public reporting describes a 243,000 sq ft data-centre proposal paired with an energy recovery centre.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: The Bunker Newbury / Greenham Common Data Centre
notes: Operational data centre at former Greenham Common command-and-control bunker near Newbury; third-party UK directory lists 3MW power capacity.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Amatis Newbury Data Centre
notes: Amatis says it owns and operates data centres in Reading and Newbury; Inflect listing gives the Newbury facility power capacity as 1.2MW.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: AMRF1 Building 3A Data Centre
notes: Planning application to West Northamptonshire Council for a data centre at Aston Martin Technology Campus, Silverstone; Construction Map lists project period 2025-07-07 to 2026-05-01 with SDC Builders as principal contractor.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Rackspace / Digital Realty Crawley LON5 data centre
notes: Crawley, West Sussex facility announced with four data suites and total 10MW capacity; Rackspace/Digital Realty unveiled the 130,000 sq ft data centre in April 2015. Later Colo-X profile reports 12MW IT load, but 10MW is retained from primary launch sources.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Stellanor Gatwick / former 4D Gatwick Data Centre
notes: Crawley/Gatwick colocation facility; Colo-X reports 400 cabinet footprints at an average 5kW across nearly 10,000 sq ft. Later listings identify the site as Stellanor Gatwick after Redcentric divestment.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Ark Spring Park DC7 expansion
developer: Ark Data Centres / Ark Estates 4 Ltd
notes: Wiltshire Council approved application PL/2024/05527 for a new standalone data-centre building and associated infrastructure at Spring Park, Corsham; DCD reports the building as 27,350 sq m and adjacent to Ark's existing Spring Park campus.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Ark Spring Park Campus
notes: Operational Corsham campus; OCOLO and Colo-X describe Spring Park as an ultra-secure data-centre campus with 46MW IT load. Ark's own site confirms Spring Park location but does not expose capacity on the crawled page.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Thames Valley Park Data Centre
developer: Project team including BCS Consultancy, Hilson Moran, Arup, Twelve Architects & Masterplanners
notes: Proposal for circa 72MW IT data centre on the Microsoft Campus at Thames Valley Park, Reading RG6 1WG, in an area identified by Wokingham Borough Council for growth. Public consultation held July 2026; planning application expected later.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: VeloxServ Wolverhampton Data Centre
notes: VeloxServ operates a privately owned Wolverhampton colocation facility; DCD reported the Midlands data centre opened after conversion of a former industrial building.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Deep Green Wolverhampton edge data centre
notes: Baxtel lists a Deep Green Wolverhampton facility as under construction with year planned 2027. No primary Deep Green project page or capacity figure found in public search results.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: IONOS Worcester Six data centre
notes: IONOS and Fasthosts opened a £21m Worcester Six Business Park data centre in October 2022; the 43,708 sq ft unit includes 30,729 sq ft data centre and 12,978 sq ft offices, with Tier IV certification announced in April 2023.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Datatech UK Alvechurch Data Center
notes: Public data-centre directories list a purpose-built Datatech UK colocation facility at Bordesley Hall, Alvechurch, opened in 2008. Capacity not verified.
